description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for measuring pack performance using bitmaps in Git. It sources external script libraries and defines test functions to set up Git configurations, create tags, and run performance tests related to bitmaps.

methods.name: test_lookup_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Sets up and runs a performance test for pack bitmaps in Git with configurable bitmap lookup table setting.

calls: git tag --message="tag pointing to HEAD" perf-tag HEAD
